## Get through: Pass an Exam

**Word Power 19 · Phrasal verbs**

### Meaning

To be successful in an exam.

### Usage

1. He has got through his exam.
2. Work hard if you want to get through this exam.

### Your turn

Use “get through: pass an exam” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
